ios.desc:
Say it once. WhisperAct turns what you say into todos, reminders and calendar events, and puts them in Apple Reminders and Apple Calendar, where you already look.

"Dentist Tuesday at 10, remind me to email the landlord Friday, pick up milk" becomes three items, each with the right date. No retyping.

SPEAK ONCE, STAY ORGANIZED
Talk naturally. WhisperAct works out what you meant and files each item in the right place. It understands phrases like "next Friday", "after lunch", "in two hours" and "end of the month", and you can tell it what "morning" and "evening" mean in your day. Check everything before it saves, or let clear items save on their own. Prefer typing? That works too.

WORKS WITH APPLE REMINDERS AND CALENDAR
Real entries in Apple's own apps, not a silo you'll forget. Notes and changes you make in Calendar come back into WhisperAct. Overlapping events are flagged, and WhisperAct can find your next free slot. Overdue reminders stay quiet instead of ringing at odd moments, and alerts you set yourself are left alone.

CAPTURE FROM ANYWHERE
Start recording with Siri, the Action Button, Control Center, a Lock Screen widget or Spotlight.

YOUR PLAN AT A GLANCE
The Plan tab shows today, what's coming up, and everything still waiting for a date. Widgets show what's next on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, and you can tick off a todo right from the widget.

REMINDERS THAT KNOW WHERE YOU ARE (PRO)
"Remind me when I get to the office." The alert comes on arrival or departure, delivered by Apple Reminders. Your location is used only while you choose the place.

REPEATING ITEMS
Daily, weekly, monthly or your own pattern. Skip one time without breaking the schedule.

A CALM DAILY RHYTHM
Daily Review is a quiet morning check, one item at a time: mark it done, reschedule it, or hide it for today. An optional evening wrap-up catches what's left, and the Daily Digest tells you what's actually scheduled. No streaks, no guilt, and silence on empty days.

HOW YOUR DATA IS HANDLED
No account needed. Your memos stay on your device, or in your private iCloud with Pro. English is transcribed on your device on supported iPhones, or by Apple. Other languages are transcribed in the cloud. To find tasks and dates, your transcript is sent securely to our AI providers, with nothing that identifies you. Offline, tasks are found on your device. Full details are in our privacy policy.

15 LANGUAGES
English, Urdu, Arabic, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Greek, Turkish, Russ
